metaDescription: Runway is a generative AI platform for creating and editing video and images with models like Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2.0. See its features, Free, Standard, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Runway is a generative AI platform for creating and editing video and images. Its own models include Gen-4.5 for text-to-video and image-to-video, and Aleph 2.0 for editing existing videos with text prompts, alongside third-party models such as Kling, Seedance and Nano Banana Pro in the same workspace.

Usage is measured in credits: each model costs a set number of credits per second of video or per image. The free plan includes a one-time deposit of 125 credits to explore, and paid plans include a monthly allotment. Developers can use the Runway Dev API, which is billed separately with pay-as-you-go credits.

features.title: Gen-4.5 video
features.text: Text-to-video and image-to-video generation, 2 to 10 seconds per clip.

features.title: Aleph 2.0 editing
features.text: Edit existing videos with text prompts and keyframe images.

features.title: Image generation
features.text: Create images with Runway and third-party image models.

features.title: Third-party models
features.text: Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana Pro and more, with full access from Pro.

features.title: Upscaling and voice
features.text: 4K video upscaling, plus Text to Speech and Custom Voices from Pro.

features.title: Team workspaces
features.text: Shared workspaces with pooled credits, commenting and free viewer seats on Team.

useCases: Short AI video clips for social and ads
Adding AI video to apps via the API
strengths: Several leading video and image models in one workspace.
Video editing as well as generation, with Aleph 2.0.
A free plan with credits that don't expire.
Yearly billing lowers the price of every paid plan.
limitations: The free plan has only 125 one-time credits and a limited set of tools.
Credits can't be bought on the free plan.
Video uses credits quickly; Standard's 625 credits cover about 52 seconds of Gen-4.5.
Access to all models and 4K upscaling needs Pro or higher.
Standard, Pro and Max are single-user; inviting members needs Team.

pricing.summary: Free plan with a one-time credit deposit. Paid plans include monthly credits; prices below are billed monthly, with yearly billing cheaper. The API (Runway Dev) is billed separately at $0.01 per credit.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 125 one-time credits · limited models · 5 GB storage

plans.name: Standard
plans.note: Or $12/mo yearly · 625 credits/mo · buy extra credits

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Or $28/mo yearly · 2,250 credits/mo · all models · 500 GB storage

plans.name: Max
plans.note: Or $76/mo yearly · 9,500 credits/mo · credits roll over one month

plans.name: Team
plans.note: Or $55/seat yearly · 2–9 seats · 6,900 pooled credits per seat
